title: Perplexity Open-Sources SPACE, a Firecracker MicroVM Sandbox for AI Agents
summary: Perplexity has open-sourced SPACE, the sandbox platform behind every task in Perplexity Computer. The Perplexity SPACE sandbox gives each agent task its own Firecracker microVM. Credentials and outbound traffic are controlled from outside that VM. The code ships under Apache 2.0 on GitHub.
